name: OnceHub
description_en:
OnceHub connects booking pages, routing forms and conversation-based scheduling to a shared scheduling engine. It distinguishes a direct booking link from a screening flow that selects a host, and from a chatbot or phone experience that guides the conversation.

A useful evaluation follows one prospect through qualification, host selection, a booked calendar event and the follow-up record. Availability, distribution policy and the plan’s channel entitlements all affect that journey.
description_zh:
OnceHub 将预约页、路由表单与对话排程连接到共同排程引擎。它区分直接预约链接、筛选后选择主持人的流程，以及聊天机器人或电话引导体验。

有效评估应跟踪一位潜在客户，从资格筛选、主持人选择到日历预约及跟进记录。可用性、分配政策和套餐渠道权益都会影响这条路径。

core_features.explanation_en: Create booking experiences and group multiple calendars in a hub, subject to plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 创建预约体验并将多个日历组织到聚合页，受套餐限制。

core_features.explanation_en: Route adds answer/contact-based screening and team distribution choices.
core_features.explanation_zh: Route 加入按回答/联系人筛选及团队分配选项。

core_features.explanation_en: Phone and web experiences reuse scheduling logic; web chatbot/live handoff is an Engage capability.
core_features.explanation_zh: 电话与网页体验复用排程逻辑；网页机器人/人工接管属于 Engage 能力。

en: A team can ask what service a visitor needs, use answers or contact properties to identify eligible advisers, then offer a suitable meeting. OnceHub distinguishes pre-assigned hosts from dynamic assignment and group sessions from concurrent separate sessions. Pick the intended meeting semantics before building the form.
zh: 团队可以询问访问者需要哪种服务，用回答或联系人属性选择合格顾问，再提供合适会议。OnceHub 区分预先指定主持人与动态分配，也区分多人共参加一场会议和同时安排多场独立会议。搭表单前应先选择正确会议含义。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: Free Basic or paid receiving-user seats; scheduling/routing/engagement tiers, SMS credits and security add-ons differ.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free Basic or paid receiving-user seats; scheduling/routing/engagement tiers, SMS credits and security add-ons differ.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Basic 免费或按接收会议用户付费；排程/路由/互动层级、短信额度及安全附加项不同。

All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: route an inquiry to an available adviser
sections.title_zh: 示例：把咨询转给可用顾问
sections.en:
A team can ask what service a visitor needs, use answers or contact properties to identify eligible advisers, then offer a suitable meeting. OnceHub distinguishes pre-assigned hosts from dynamic assignment and group sessions from concurrent separate sessions. Pick the intended meeting semantics before building the form.

Test an unqualified answer, a qualified request with no available host and an existing CRM owner. A routing form is only useful if the booked host and saved contact record match the intended rule. This is a proposed evaluation, not a tested integration or a measured lead-conversion improvement.
sections.zh:
团队可以询问访问者需要哪种服务，用回答或联系人属性选择合格顾问，再提供合适会议。OnceHub 区分预先指定主持人与动态分配，也区分多人共参加一场会议和同时安排多场独立会议。搭表单前应先选择正确会议含义。

建议测试不符合资格、符合资格但无人可约，以及 CRM 已有负责人三种情况。实际预约主持人及联系人记录符合规则，路由表单才算有效。这是评估建议，未经集成测试，也未测量线索转化提升。

sections.en:
Basic is free for one user, one connected calendar and one booking link. Paid Schedule adds unlimited links/calendars and integrations; Route adds screening/distribution, while Engage adds web chatbots and live handoff. The pricing text exposes paired monthly/yearly seat figures of $12/$10 for Schedule, $23/$19 for Route and $47/$39 for Engage. Confirm the selected cadence, currency code and final quote rather than treating both values as one price.

The FAQ says users receiving meetings or live engagements require paid seats, while an administrator who does neither does not need one. Trial access is Engage for 14 days with no card; Basic requires choosing a downgrade. SMS requires credits, and security/compliance features can be a paid add-on. Free basic scheduling does not imply free compliance controls or unlimited conversational usage.
sections.zh:
Basic 免费，含一位用户、一个连接日历及一个预约链接。付费 Schedule 加入不限链接/日历和集成；Route 加筛选及分配；Engage 加网页机器人与人工接管。定价文本同时显示月付/年付席位数字：Schedule $12/$10、Route $23/$19、Engage $47/$39。需确认所选周期、货币代码与最终报价，不能把两个数字当作同一价格。

FAQ 表示接收会议或实时互动的用户需要付费席位，不接收这两类工作的管理员不需要。无需卡的试用为 Engage 14 天，之后使用 Basic 需要选择降级。短信需要额度，安全合规功能可能为付费附加项。基础排程免费，不表示合规控制或所有对话用量免费。

sections.title_en: AI, phone numbers and security controls
sections.en:
The price cards include different numbers of phone numbers across paid tiers and list additional numbers at $4 per month. That does not specify every calling-country, duration or recording condition. Establish those before offering a public phone service. The detailed comparison says AI is off by default and must be enabled by the account owner.

SSO, corporate calendar connections, provisioning and BAA-related options appear under the security/compliance add-on or Enterprise. Their presence does not certify a buyer’s own workflow. Prepare identity roles, consent and required data handling separately from the booking-page design.
sections.zh:
付费卡片包含不同数量的电话号码，额外号码列为每月 $4；这不说明所有通话国家、时长或录音条件。公开提供电话服务前应确认。详细比较表示 AI 默认关闭，必须由账户所有者启用。

SSO、企业日历连接、用户配置及 BAA 相关选项出现在安全合规附加项或 Enterprise 中。它们的存在不等于买家流程已获得合规认证。身份角色、同意及数据处理要求应与预约页设计分别准备。

sections.title_en: Start with one link before adding handoffs
sections.title_zh: 先做一个链接，再加入交接
sections.en:
Connect the intended calendar, set working hours, lead time, buffers and a booking limit, then verify one booked event. Add routing, CRM writes and conversational channels only after their expected result is defined. If a downstream contact update is missing, compare the source meeting/activity before repeating the operation. API/webhook availability is not proof of receiver-side retry or deduplication.

This managed platform may suit service and sales teams needing guided scheduling. No self-hosting distribution, software licence, live phone, chatbot, payment, recovery or performance test was verified here.
sections.zh:
连接计划使用的日历，设置营业时间、提前量、缓冲和预约上限，再验证一个已预约事件。明确预期结果后，再加入路由、CRM 写入及对话渠道。下游联系人更新遗漏时，应先对照来源会议/活动，再重复操作。可用 API/Webhook 不证明接收端已实现重试或去重。

这套托管平台可供需要引导式排程的服务与销售团队评估。本文未核实自托管发行版、软件许可，也未实际测试电话、机器人、付款、恢复或性能。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Final currency/cadence, phone metering/countries, SMS credit costs, account permissions, licences and recovery were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试最终货币/周期、电话计量/国家、短信额度费用、账户权限、许可及恢复。

research_gaps.en: No booking, CRM, API, chatbot or phone-agent execution was performed; regulatory suitability remains unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际运行预约、CRM、API、聊天机器人或电话代理；监管适用性未核实。
